label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebration for the mayor, with eight lanterns in the great hall and 200 fresh loaves distributed among four feast tables; the mayor was deliberately kept unaware until the planned reveal at day 1, 18:00. Innkeeper arranged the escort, freight arranged supplies and bread transport, builder installed lanterns and assisted with deliveries, and baker supplied and baked the loaves. The record shows no knowing help by the secretary or neighbour; they are not included as helpers. The celebration was underway and the bread and lantern setup were verified, although the final arrival/reveal is not logged in the supplied record.
